items.title: Kubernetes major release: upgrade checklist
items.summary: In this fictional example, a Kubernetes release changes the supported upgrade path and removes APIs used by older workloads. A useful briefing would identify the exact versions, name the affected APIs, and explain which cluster add-ons need compatibility checks before rollout. This is not a live release notice.
items.why_it_matters: Platform teams may need to check compatibility before upgrading.
items.next_action: Review supported versions and release notes.

items.title: PHP security advisory: check exposure
items.summary: In this fictional example, a PHP security advisory describes a flaw that applies only to specific versions and deployment conditions. No real vulnerability or installation impact is claimed.
items.why_it_matters: You follow PHP; your actual exposure is unknown.
items.next_action: Check the official advisory and your installed version.

items.title: AI model update: API changes to assess
items.summary: In this fictional example, a model provider changes API availability and response behavior for an updated model. A useful briefing would explain what changed in requests or outputs, describe relevant migration steps, and point to documentation for compatibility and evaluation. It makes no claim about a real model launch.
items.why_it_matters: Teams may need to evaluate compatibility before adopting a model.
